headline: PolyGraph reports plan-buffered CUDA Graph capture for adaptive speculative decoding
summary: The PolyGraph preprint proposes one maximum-grid CUDA Graph with GPU-resident updates for changing speculative-decoding shapes. Its abstract reports a single-H800 trace-driven prototype that replaces 64 shape-specific graphs with one, gives warmed P50 latency of 17.7 vs 17.8 ms and cuts graph-build time from 3,915 to 93 ms. The author also reports a P99 benefit that depends on padding waste. This is a bounded synthetic-trace result, not a production serving demonstration; independent reproduction remains open. The arXiv page says the v1 was submitted on 14 August 2026 despite the identifier prefix 2610, an unexplained metadata discrepancy.
